name: Evaluation Kit Shelf
description: Non-indexed evaluation datasets (golden evals, retrieval evals, workflow tests) approved for Cerebrum kit use.

packs.name: AEC-Bench Construction Document Intelligence Evaluation Kit
packs.description: 196 real AEC task harnesses for cross-sheet drawing/spec/submittal reasoning. Harness and metadata are Apache-2.0; underlying third-party AEC documents require separate rights clearance.
excluded_components: External PDFs (~5.6 GB) until document rights are cleared
Keyword-based verifiers should be treated as brittle

packs.name: TechManualQA-700 Technical Manual Retrieval Evaluation Kit
packs.description: 700 validated QA pairs for technical manuals with doc_id/page_number references, human audit subset and RAGAS scores. CC-BY-4.0 annotations; source PDFs are not included.
packs.source_publisher: Tomislav Duricic (Graz University of Technology / Know-Center GmbH)
excluded_components: Source technical manual PDFs are not included and must be obtained separately
requires_raw_sources: 20 technical manual PDFs listed at https://github.com/tduricic/techmanualqa
